tracks.title: Diều Đê Ngõ Chợ
tracks.subject: kids of one Hanoi alley off the Yên Phụ dike road hauling every kite they own up onto the dike on one windy dry-season afternoon, trying to keep as many in the air at once as they can, until their strings tangle with the kites from the next alley and both gangs end up on the slope unknotting them together (not a formal contest)
